$comment: Birthplace catalog (Ticket 0201). One entry per city, each carrying its region and country so a birth is a single weighted draw — nesting country/region/city would misweight countries by how many of their cities happen to be catalogued. `weight` is a birth-likelihood weight, loosely population-shaped, NOT a population. `nameCultures` is the mix a character born there draws a name from; every city has a mix, because every real city does. US weight is dominant while salary, property and price content is US-benchmarked — a content gap, not a design statement.
